title: Prostasomes -  Proteomic profiling of detergent resistant membranes (lipid rafts) of prostasomes
projectDescription: Which proteins can be found in rafts enriched from human semen.
sampleProcessingProtocol: Enrichment by differential centrifugation. For proteomics the sample was solubilized with sds which then was substituted by urea using the spinfilter method.
dataProcessingProtocol: Search through Mascot human database from SwissProt.
